record_title: Rank-three mechanism obstruction and a correction to Bao's Example 6.3
provenance: SCOPE Phase II research record. Review evidence is documented in REVIEW.md.
limitations: The correction uses Bao's Theorem 1.3 as stated and does not independently reprove the full rank formula. Originality is to the best of our knowledge. The motivating preprint is very recent and may be revised; an unindexed contemporaneous correction remains a residual risk. Bremner's original full text was not independently inspected, although Bao reproduces and proves the relevant low-degree criterion. No independent validation is asserted.
